finding.headline: "The I Stopped Taking Care of Myself new mum (identity recovery market)."
finding.problem: A 4-month-postpartum Nigerian/African mum has lost her sense of self to motherhood; she grieves the old her, feels guilt for grieving, and has no village (omugwo ended / diaspora isolation). Research: 62% of mothers feel identity loss (Psychology Today/Peanut–Tommee Tippee 2023); Nigeria Health Watch documents PPD identity crisis; WHO notes Nigerians "most depressed in Africa."
